citations.title: Best Restaurants at Singapore Changi Airport Worth Trying
citations.content:
Most airport restaurants open by mid morning and many close around 10 p.m., but each terminal preserves at least a handful of 24 hour eateries and convenience style counters for very late or early departures. Operating hours can change with traffic patterns, so it is wise to have a backup option in mind if you are arriving particularly late at night.

...

On

...

In Terminal 3 transit, Encik Tan and similar quick service stalls draw lines for local noodles and rice dishes that are both familiar to Singaporeans and accessible to visitors. A typical bowl of curry noodles or fishball noodles costs in the S$6 to S$8 range, and many travellers comment that the flavours compare well with mid tier food courts in the city. Because orders are placed and collected at the counter, it works well if you have only 30 to 40 minutes before boarding and just want a hot, comforting meal.

findings.title: T3免费Snooze Lounge（南/北各一处）
findings.summary: 樟宜机场T3国际中转区Level 2设有两处免费Snooze Lounge，分别位于南翼（靠近GST退税柜台）和北翼（靠近儿童游乐场），均24小时开放，适合短时躺卧休息。但为公共空间，无隐私，更适合短 nap 而非深度睡眠。无需入境即可使用。

findings.title: Ambassador Transit Lounge（T3中转区Level 3）
findings.summary: 位于T3国际中转区Level 3的付费休息室，24小时营业，提供淋浴、自助餐、商务工作区及付费小睡房（6小时约S$120，每小时加收S$20）。适合需要更舒适休息或淋浴的旅客。无需入境，但需付费入场或使用符合条件的信用卡/会员资格。

findings.title: Ambassador Transit Hotel（T3中转区Level 3）
findings.summary: 位于T3国际中转区Level 3（电影院旁）的过境酒店，24小时运营，提供按小时计费的客房休息。自2026年10月1日起运营商将变更为Changi Transit Hotel，预订需转至新网站。适合需要私密睡眠空间的旅客，无需入境新加坡。

findings.title: 新加坡美食街 T3 Transit（Singapore Food Street）
findings.summary: 位于T3国际中转区的美食街，提供鸡饭、椰浆饭、肉骨茶等本地风味。但营业时间未在检索资料中明确确认是否24小时开放，可能受夜间航班流量影响调整。建议抵达后现场确认是否仍在营业。

findings.title: O'Coffee Club T3 Public
findings.summary: 检索结果显示O'Coffee Club在T3有24小时营业的Public区（陆侧）门店，但明确标注为"Public"而非"Transit"。国际中转区（空侧）是否有同品牌24小时营业门店、以及是否可从T3中转区直接到达，此信息未在检索中确认。无法确认该选项是否适用于不入境旅客。

findings.title: Encik Tan等快餐档口（T3 Transit）
findings.summary: T3国际中转区内有Encik Tan等快餐式档口，提供咖喱面、鱼丸面等本地面食，价格约S$6-S$8，柜台点单取餐适合短时用餐。但检索资料仅提及"many close around 10 p.m."，未明确确认这些档口是否24小时营业或夜间具体开放时间。
